name: ackless
description: Open-source browser extension that hides Australian Welcome to Country and Acknowledgement of Country blocks.

scripts.check: ultracite check && tsc --noEmit && vitest run && node scripts/build.mjs && web-ext lint --source-dir dist --ignore-files package.json bun.lock README.md LICENSE CONTRIBUTING.md test-page.html
scripts.build:chrome: bun run build && (cd dist && zip -r ackless-chrome.zip manifest.json icons src README.md LICENSE)
scripts.build:firefox: bun run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir dist --overwrite-dest --ignore-files package.json bun.lock README.md CONTRIBUTING.md test-page.html
